subject: science
name: Science
course: Matter Interactions, Ecosystem Energy, Earth's Spheres & Space Systems
title: Grade 5 Science: Matter Interactions, Ecosystem Energy, Earth's Spheres & Space Systems
overview: Grade 5 Science engages students in the scientific method and engineering design process across physical, life, and Earth/space sciences aligned with Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS).
competencies: Ask scientific questions, plan and conduct controlled investigations, and analyze experimental data.
Develop and use models to describe natural systems, energy flows, and physical interactions.
Construct explanations supported by empirical evidence and scientific reasoning.
Design, test, and optimize engineering solutions to real-world technological and environmental problems.

modules.title: Matter and Its Interactions: Particle Nature & Conservation of Mass
modules.description: Modeling matter as microscopic particles, proving conservation of mass in chemical and physical changes, and identifying mystery substances.

topics.title: The Particle Model of Matter
topics.description: Using models to demonstrate that gases, liquids, and solids are made of particles too small to be seen.

topics.title: Conservation of Mass During Physical and Chemical Changes
topics.description: Weighing substances before and after dissolving, melting, or chemical reactions to prove mass conservation.

topics.title: Identifying Materials by Chemical/Physical Properties
topics.description: Testing conductivity, solubility, magnetism, and reactivity to identify unknown substances.

modules.title: Energy and Matter in Organisms and Ecosystems
modules.description: Tracing the flow of energy from the Sun to plants (photosynthesis) and through food webs, decomposing organisms, and matter recycling.

topics.title: Plant Photosynthesis: Water and Air to Sugar
topics.description: Showing that plant mass comes primarily from air and water rather than soil.

topics.title: Ecosystem Food Webs and Decomposers
topics.description: Modeling how matter cycles between air, soil, producers, consumers, and decomposers.

modules.title: Earth's Four Spheres & Water Distribution
modules.description: Investigating interactions among the geosphere, biosphere, hydrosphere, and atmosphere, and protecting Earth's freshwater.

topics.title: The Four Interacting Spheres of Earth
topics.description: Modeling how rainfall (hydrosphere) shapes rock (geosphere) and supports forests (biosphere).

topics.title: Global Water Distribution and Freshwater Conservation
topics.description: Graphing the distribution of saltwater (97%) versus accessible freshwater (less than 1%).

modules.title: Space Systems: Stars and the Solar System
modules.description: Exploring gravitational pull toward Earth's center, comparing star brightness by distance, and shadow/day-night patterns.

topics.title: Earth's Gravitational Force
topics.description: Proving that gravitational force directed down toward the center of Earth pulls all objects equally.

topics.title: Star Brightness, Solar Distance & Planetary Orbits
topics.description: Explaining why the Sun appears larger and brighter than other stars due to relative distance.
